places-segment-chiwuanquiri-belen-square.story: A 318 km round trip from Quehue - roughly 5 h 29 in the saddle. The stops in between: Segment Cusipata-Santa Cruz de Occobamba N, Belén Square and Church and back through Segment Cusipata-Santa Cruz de Occobamba N. The highest point is about 4,450 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

legend-atlantic-coast-n247.slogan: Atlantic Coast N247 – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-atlantic-coast-n247.story: curated scenic road. Atlantic coast, cliffs, surf towns. From Lisbon it runs 101 km to Peniche; allow about 1 h 50 of riding. It goes by way of Cascais, Colares and Ericeira. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Atlantic Coast N247
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 25 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
